scope: Frieza Race Skills catalog set reconciliation

findings.name: Darkness Rush (Melee)
findings.note: The current Frieza Race Skills category includes this skill. Current Xenoverse 2 skill references identify the melee variant as a CaC-usable Strike Ultimate; the broader availability boundary should be handled by skill-level evidence, not by the race-category membership alone.

findings.name: Turn Golden
findings.note: The current Frieza Race Skills category includes Turn Golden, and current reference material identifies it as a Frieza Race CaC-only Awoken Skill obtained through Frieza/ Cooler's Frieza Spaceship Time Rift training. The page reports 300 Ki activation cost and +30% Ki Blast damage / +20% speed effects.

historical_discrepancy: Earlier repository notes expected four Frieza Race Skills. Current source evidence exposes two; no source-only records exist. The discrepancy is therefore closed as historical/source drift rather than an omitted current record.
